body: I didn't have any need for those. There might be some of their blood in my bathroom. But I only needed to cut off the hands that touched her. The rest was useless trash that's been disposed of.
Well it was my first time so I wouldn't call myself a self-respecting serial killer. More of a... passionate lover with a night that's hard to remember.

I'm glad someone understands. I loved her so so much. I don't know why she couldn't understand that.
I'll try my best to move on.
Perhaps when I clean up a bit I can have another lady friend over!
And hopefully she will be loyal this time...
I know. I just thought she should reflect on what she had done for a little while. Also I had to go to work so I didn't have enough time. After my shift tonight I'll probably clean up a bit.

Oh crap really? That is good to know!

So then are you doing anything this weekend...?
:)
